scope: research-only replacement drafts; no production writes or acceptance claims
confirmed_defects: universal 3.1 saturation uses inverse embedding with a subset of the wrong member as its argument; use the forward image.

universal 6.1 restricts a component at a Sigma endpoint and falsely claims it is inextendible at both ends; replace with compatible chronological-side decomposition and consecutive crossing contradiction.
universal 4.1 claims arbitrary time-orientation representing vectors agree on overlaps; only their future cones agree after the definition repair.
universal clauses (d)-(e) need a nonempty family but the original global hypothesis does not assume existence of one development.
dense 1.2 incorrectly treats negative flow parameters as future chords, omits zero-time case, and does not keep track of member-local endpoint neighborhoods.
dense 2.1 incorrectly equates the exact inverse endpoint error to a generally nonzero distance between the source and endpoint; the exact inverse error is zero.
dense 2.1 falsely places a point at stage i instead of stage m+1 when its source lies in D_m; bases also must be retained consistently across stages.

second-countable 2.1 assumes an arbitrary prechosen tiny W_d reaches p and that a centered ball can be fitted around a nonzero inverse velocity inside an arbitrary open neighborhood; neither is valid.

interface_changes.lem-gr-universal-development: Adds existence of one development; carries generic fixed admissible full-data model and restart hypotheses; strengthens (d) to actual second countability, preserving global smooth N via PU after elementary local countability proof. Future cones are preserved, not equality of representing N fields.
interface_changes.lem-gr-development-quotient-dense-set: Retains both density clauses and explicit timelike rational recursion; makes fixed-on-first-occurrence tangent bases precise and declares the already used Dependent Choice supplier.
interface_changes.lem-gr-development-quotient-second-count: Replaces unsound centered-balls-in-one-fixed-domain claim with explicit countable basis of all rational translated tangent balls on which exp is diffeomorphic.

dependency_order: universal depends on local geometry/separability/countable unions/PU and supplies standalone dense, then standalone second-countability; universal has no dependency on either later lemma.

source_reading.full_text: Existing extracted Sbierski arXiv:1309.7591v3 text, all 1341 lines read in overlapping chunks; Theorems 2.7-2.8 proof studied in full.
source_reading.local_suppliers: Read geometry joint-exp and convex-normal suppliers, temporal splitting, subdevelopment convexity, Cauchy side/topology, portion inextendibility, smooth PU, current full-data development definition.
source_reading.not_claimed: No fresh full-text reading of Geroch, Minguzzi or Chrusciel is claimed. The elementary replacement is proved locally; bibliography entries are retained as provenance.

consumer_ownership: Parent owns all direct and indirect consumer checks, metadata/contracts and production integration. No independent or native acceptance recorded.
